title: The Healing of the Royal Official's Son
description: A royal official from Capernaum went to Jesus in Cana and asked him to come and heal his dying son. Jesus told him that his son would live, and the man believed what Jesus said and left. On his way home, his servants met him and told him that his boy had recovered at the exact hour Jesus spoke. The father and all his household came to believe. This was the second sign Jesus performed in Galilee.
